abstract: A 10-year-old premenarchal girl was admitted to our hospital with moderate abdominal pain, although presenting no vomiting or abdominal rebound tenderness. A large abdominal mass was visible and palpable in the periumbilical and epigastric regions. Results of physical examination revealed that the general health status was satisfactory. Computed tomographic scan revealed a large, thin-walled cyst occupying nearly the entire peritoneal cavity. The other viscera were of normal aspect. A laparoscopic approach revealed a left ovarian cystic tumor that was twisted 360 degrees in conjunction with the uterine corpus with hemorrhagic infarction. A partial hysterectomy and a left salpingo-oophorectomy were carried out. The tumor was classified as mature cystic teratoma of the ovary accompanied by hemorrhagic necrosis, not only of the cyst but also of the left uterine tube and the uterine corpus.
abstract_ja: 10歳の初経前女児が、中等度の腹痛で当院を受診した。嘔吐や腹部の反跳痛はなかった。臍周囲から心窩部にかけて大きな腹部腫瘤が視診・触診で認められた。全身状態は良好であった。CT検査では、腹腔のほぼ全体を占める大きく薄壁の嚢胞が確認された。他の臓器は正常に見えた。腹腔鏡下の観察で、左卵巣の嚢胞性腫瘍が子宮体部とともに360度捻転し、出血性梗塞を起こしていることが判明した。子宮部分切除術および左卵管卵巣摘出術を施行した。腫瘍は、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、嚢胞だけでなく左卵管および子宮体部にも出血性壊死を伴うと分類された。
